title: Vector addition
target: Add displacement vectors and use a model to explain where an object ends up.
criteria: Place arrows tip to tail without rotating them.
Combine east-west and north-south components separately.
State the resultant with units and a clear direction.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: To add displacement B to A tip-to-tail, what is done to B?
options: Rotate it until both point the same way.
Place its tip at A’s tail and reverse it.
Translate it so its tail meets A’s tip without changing its direction or length.
cpa.guide: A free vector can be translated while preserving magnitude and direction.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: After two displacements are placed tip-to-tail, where does the resultant arrow run?
options: Between the two individual arrow tips only.
From the first tail to the last tip.
From the last tip back to the first tail.
cpa.guide: The resultant connects the overall start to the overall finish.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: Displacement A is 8 m east and 3 m north. B is 5 m west and 4 m north. What are total components?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A drone moves 9 m south, then 4 m north and 6 m east. What are net components?
cpa.guide: North-south sum is −9 + 4 = −5; east component is +6.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A displacement has components 5 m west and 12 m north. What are magnitude and general direction?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A route totals 10 m east, 6 m north, and 10 m west. Which describes its distance and displacement?
cpa.guide: East-west components cancel, while path length includes every leg.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
